d.title: Sell. Buy. Projects. Finance.
d.sub: One market for all of it — with verified businesses only.
d.heroAlt: SELYVO Market’s Home: what needs you today, your balance, offers due and your business network

story.title: From an idea to a paid invoice.
story.sub: Seven steps, one record. Follow a purchase through SELYVO Market — on its real screens.

verified.title: Every business. Checked.
verified.sub: SELYVO opens by invitation. Each business is found in its register, its VAT number and the sanctions lists are checked, and it answers SELYVO’s questions before its first deal.
kpis: that buyer and supplier both see
by card up front, or by invoice

d.gtkSub: The details members notice on their first day — and are glad of every day after.

invite.title: Open by invitation.
invite.sub: Every company on SELYVO is known to at least one other. Ask a customer or a supplier who is a member to invite you — or write to us.

d.title: Sell to verified buyers.
d.sub: List what you sell, answer the requests in your categories, and follow every case from the first lead to the outcome.

story.title: From the first lead to a clear outcome.
story.sub: Every case runs through the pipeline you see in Sales.

steps.title: A lead comes in.
steps.text: From a customer of yours, a new business on SELYVO, or prospects AI finds. Each lead opens a case with its next step.

steps.title: A request arrives.
steps.text: Requests and enquiries in your categories turn the interest into an opportunity — the case moves on by itself.

steps.title: Your offer goes out.
steps.text: Answer the request with an offer, or send a targeted offer to the customers you choose.

steps.title: You agree the terms.
steps.text: Responses and bidding stay on the case, and both sides see the same record.

steps.title: Won or lost — on record.
steps.text: Every case ends with a clear outcome, and your conversion and win rate count themselves.

d.title: Buy from suppliers you can trust.
d.sub: Describe what you need, compare offers line by line from verified suppliers, and send the order — every step on record.

story.title: From a need to an approved order.
story.sub: The request that brings the offers, the order that follows.

steps.title: Describe what you need.
steps.text: Type it, or drop a specification, a tender or a bill of quantities — AI fills in the title, the category, the lines, the delivery and the budget.

steps.title: Choose who quotes.
steps.text: Your own suppliers, businesses on SELYVO, or more found by AI. Before AI searches, the button says what it will cost: about 0.60 EUR.

steps.title: Offers come in.
steps.text: Each supplier says whether it will send an offer, and the offers arrive on the request by the date you set.

steps.title: Pick the best.
steps.text: Compare the offers line by line or by lot, and award the best one.

steps.title: The order goes out.
steps.text: The offer you accept becomes the purchase order. Both sides follow it to delivery and invoice.

d.title: Projects, with the budget in sight.
d.sub: Milestones, team, time, expenses and purchases in one project. The budget counts itself, and the customer follows along.

story.title: Plan it. Do it. Bill it.
story.sub: A customer project from its milestones to the invoice.

steps.title: Plan it.
steps.text: Milestones with their amounts, the team and the budget — your people and your suppliers in one project.

steps.title: Do the work.
steps.text: Time sheets, expenses and purchases land in the project as the work is done.

steps.title: The customer accepts.
steps.text: Each milestone is accepted by the customer, who follows the project with you.

steps.title: Bill it.
steps.text: Accepted milestones go on the invoice, and the budget shows what is committed, actual and billed.

d.title: Invoice. Check. Get paid.
d.sub: Invoices made from their orders, every invoice you receive checked at SELYVO, and payments from your own account.

story.title: Every invoice checked before anyone looks.
story.sub: An invoice you receive, from its arrival to its payment.

steps.title: An invoice arrives.
steps.text: By e-mail to invoice@market.selyvo.com, as a file, or on SELYVO — read by AI and matched to its business.

steps.title: SELYVO checks it.
steps.text: Every field the law asks for, your details, and each line against the order and what you received. If you choose, one that fails goes back to its supplier by itself.

steps.title: You approve it.
steps.text: Approved invoices wait to be paid, soonest due first.

steps.title: Paid from your own account.
steps.text: Pay from your Revolut Business on the due dates or now. Within your limit, payments go at once; above it, they wait for your approvers.

d.title: Every order, accepted to paid.
d.sub: One order, one timeline, the same record for both sides — in parts if needed.

story.title: Where it stands. Always.
story.sub: An order follows the same steps you see on it in SELYVO.

steps.title: The order is placed.
steps.text: From the accepted offer, or straight from a listing. Both sides see the same order.

steps.title: The supplier accepts.
steps.text: The supplier accepts the order, with its delivery date.

steps.title: Delivered, with its note.
steps.text: Each delivery comes with its delivery note — in parts if needed.

steps.title: You confirm what arrived.
steps.text: In full or in part. Something wrong? Say so on the note, and the supplier is told at once.

steps.title: The invoice follows.
steps.text: Made from the order after the receipt — and checked at SELYVO when it arrives.

steps.title: Paid on its due date.
steps.text: By card up front or by invoice, as the supplier decides — and both sides see it paid.

d.title: Know who you deal with.
d.sub: Every business is invited, found in its register, checked and qualified before it trades. Every record keeps its history.

d.title: Your own processes. One foundation.
d.sub: SELYVO Core gives larger organisations their own workspace — suppliers, questionnaires, catalogues and process flows with AI checks — connected to SELYVO Market.
